3. Specify a song: song_name
4. Specify an artist: @artist_name

You can enable this option to save power consumption, but on some devices there may be an issue where all songs prompt "Error loading music" or "Unable to play the whole song in full", this is due to a bug in the current system. 

For those experiencing this issue you can turn off the option and restart the app completely and try again.

import__desc: Bring your liked songs, playlists, followed artists and saved albums from another app. Songs are looked up on NetEase and Kuwo first, then on SoundCloud and YouTube. You check the results before anything is added.
import__file_tip: CSV / TXT lists (Exportify, TuneMyMusic, Soundiiz, or one "Artist - Title" per line), Spotify's data export (YourLibrary.json, Playlist1.json), Apple Music's data export, Google Takeout (YouTube Music playlists, CSV). Files named like "Liked songs" go into Loved, the others become playlists.
import__link_placeholder: Paste a playlist, album or profile link
import__link_tip: Playlists and albums from Spotify, Deezer, Apple Music, YouTube, SoundCloud, NetEase, QQ Music, Kuwo and Kugou. Profiles from SoundCloud, Deezer, Last.fm and NetEase.

import__spotify_limit: Spotify only shows the first 100 songs of a playlist link. For the whole playlist, export it as a CSV file (for example with Exportify) and import the file.

setting__sources_add_tip: For sources that aren't in the addon store: paste a link to a source script, or choose a .js file. Music API scripts and source addons both work here.

setting__sources_store_tip: Install with one tap. Third-party sources are made and hosted by their authors: LX Music+ links to them but doesn't make or check them.
setting__sources_store_all_tip: Installs everything in the addon store at once and turns it on.

setting__sources_no_batch_tip: Its author doesn't allow batch downloads, so while it's in use LX Music+ only downloads one song at a time. To download several songs at once, use another Music API.
download__batch_blocked:
The Music API in use ({name}) doesn't allow batch downloads, so LX Music+ only downloads one song at a time with it.

To download several songs at once, switch to another Music API in Settings → Sources.
setting__sources_api_group_tip: Plays NetEase, QQ Music, Kugou, Kuwo and Migu. One Music API is used at a time.
setting__sources_addon_group_tip: Play YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp and KHInsider. LX Music+ doesn't include their audio. Addons for NetEase, QQ Music, Kugou, Kuwo or Migu (e.g. GD Studio) are a backup: they play a song when the Music API can't.
player__no_source:
LX Music+ has no source installed that can play {platform} songs.

Add one in Settings → Sources. Install all there gets the default sources.
